$comment: The token naming grammar, declared once. Read by lint-naming-canon.mjs, lint-token-purpose-slots.mjs, the grammar vitest and the token-anatomy docs check. Spec: docs/adrs/ADR-043-system-id-token-prefix.md (ID, shape, reserved words) and ADR-033 (vocabularies). Vocabularies moved verbatim from the hardcoded sets those scripts held; changing a word here changes the gate.

ids.$comment: ADR-043 section 3. An agent may propose token values, never token names and never IDs: a new ID is a brik-bds PR to this registry, reviewed by a human.

bds.library: Foundations + the default (Brik) Brand Kit that ships in dist/tokens.css

namedFamilies.$comment: #2677, ratified by the operator 2026-10-01. Non-numeric colour families: body is color-{family}-{name}, {name} from the closed list. A new name is a PR to this file. #2689: every family states its purpose in $purposes; a name that does not fit its family's purpose belongs in another family.

$purposes.system: Messaging colours (error, success, warning, neutral, info, plus link blue and accent hues) for Alert, Badge and Toast; components never read them directly, they read the Semantic that aliases them.
$purposes.social: Third-party brand marks (YouTube, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Yelp, Google, Apple, Bing, TikTok) used by SocialIcon; these are the platforms' colours, not Brik's, and no brand kit rebinds them.
$purposes.annotation: Annotation-tooling colours (pink, purple, blue and their light tints) used to mark up designs and docs, never product UI.

namedSteps.$comment: #2677: named endpoints of a numeric family.

$purposes.grayscale: black and white are foundation constants every brand guide carries; a brand kit never rebinds grayscale-black or grayscale-white.

semantic.$comment: Two forms. formula is the colour Semantic (a purpose leads); roleFormula is the non-colour Semantic, a role from roles plus a step (--gap-md, --heading-xl). #2743.

component.stemRule: The first body segment is the component stem. It may not begin with a reserved word (ADR-043 section 5).

reservedWords.$comment: ADR-043 section 5. The first body segment names the tier: color or a scale word is Primitive, a purpose or role word is Semantic, anything else is a Component stem. Derived from tiers above; the vitest asserts they agree.

steps.$comment: ADR-033 section 3 as amended by #2594. tShirt is the lint-naming-canon rule-1 vocabulary; slotAuditTShirt is the narrower set lint-token-purpose-slots has always classified with (no 3xs/3xl) - kept distinct so its output is unchanged.

familySteps.$comment: ADR-033 section Amendments, #1285. Step words legal in ONE body-keyed family only, ordered low to high. `nano` is three fixed rungs below `tiny`, mode-invariant, padding only.

segments.$comment: Word-level rules for every segment of a token name, brik-bds#3088. Read by lint-tokens.js (Tier 4 shape, rule tier4-shape) and lint-naming-canon.mjs (rule 8). The anatomy page is token-anatomy.mdx § About Tier 4. OPERATOR SAID 2026-11-11 (chat): "yes -bg should be banned - we should be following strict naming logic across all our environments". Spell every segment as a full word; the only short forms are allowedAbbreviations, the T-shirt steps in a step slot, and the axis letters x and y.

suggestions.$comment: The full word for a banned segment that has an unambiguous one. A banned segment absent here is reported without a suggestion: spell it out.

segments.allowedAbbreviationsSource: OPERATOR CHOSE 2026-11-11: which short forms stay allowed in token names → "Acronyms cta / ghl / dns, T-shirt steps sm/md/lg, Axis letters x / y". The T-shirt steps live in steps.tShirt, which are legal in a step slot only, so a Tier 4 {part} or {property} segment may not be one.

bannedJoinedStems.$comment: A component name written as one run-on word. The kebab form is the only spelling.

bannedParts.$comment: A Tier 4 {part} names a sub-element. A prop, a position or a state word names none, so it cannot stand in the {part} slot.

docs.$comment: token-anatomy.mdx must contain, verbatim, the formula strings derived from tiers above: --{semantic.formula}, --{semantic.roleFormula}, --{primitive.color.body}, --{ids.componentId}-{component.body}, plus the shape (--{id}-{body}) and the scale body (--{primitive.scale.body}) (scripts/lint-naming-grammar-docs.mjs). #2666 rewrote the page around them.
